hypothesis: The RETRIEVAL_REFUTER gap (7/18 Sonnet-quoted spans in BM25 top-8) is closed, or measurably narrowed, by four changes: (a) bound retrieval by an ~8000-token budget instead of a hard k=8 count, so more of the ranking is admitted; (b) hard-filter passages from a witness or session the claim explicitly names to the front; (c) add a second ranker, nomic-embed-text cosine over the same passages (cached to disk, keyed by corpus hash), fused with BM25 by reciprocal rank fusion, to reach evidence phrased without the claim's terms (BM25 rank>40 or score 0, e.g. Jo Porter's bare 'Absolutely inadequate.'); (d) a fused-top-score floor that returns 'absent' from code with retrieved=0 and no model call when nothing clears it. Refuter target: all 18 spans' passages in the retrieved set for the 5 real claims. Two of the 18 (F8 bendigo, F8 community-music) were NO-PASSAGE-MATCH under exact-substring because Sonnet's quote is non-verbatim (source says 'creative sector', Sonnet wrote 'arts sector'); the refuter's passage-locator moves to token-overlap so a lightly-edited quote is still pinned to its passage.
alternatives_considered: keep k-count cap and only add embeddings — rejected: k=8 structurally excludes rank>8 evidence regardless of ranker quality; the token budget is what admits the fused re-ranking

compute embeddings live in every run — rejected: go test / the refuter would then require a running ollama + nomic-embed-text; disk cache keyed by corpus hash lets the first run (ollama up) compute and commit, and every later run (tests included) read offline

force 18/18 by loosening the refuter's match threshold until all pass — rejected: that is weakening the measurement to hit the number; the locator is fixed to pin quotes to passages honestly, coverage is then measured, and if <18/18 that is the report per the step-1 spec

floor on the raw RRF score — rejected as the sole signal: RRF top is ~0.03 for both relevant and off-topic claims (embeddings always return a nearest); floor is defined on the top passage's semantic cosine, which actually separates present from absent
label: advantage
rationale: Shipped. Refuter coverage rose 7/18 (BM25 top-8) to 12/18 (fused, token cap 8000), 0 unmatched (the tail/middle-window locator now pins the 2 non-verbatim Sonnet quotes; one, bendigo#t15, is a genuine Sonnet misquote: source says 'creative sector', Sonnet wrote 'arts sector'). Not 18/18 — the report, per spec, and we stop. The 6 misses split: 3 unreachable by ANY ranker (fused rank 184/604/1303: a bare 'Absolutely inadequate.', a generic line, a cross-reference — near-zero BM25 AND cosine), and 3 reachable only past a ~35K-token budget (rank 17/76/78), which would trade away retrieval's purpose. DEVIATION FROM SPEC, flagged: fusion is reciprocal-rank fusion combined by MAX (best rank), not the canonical sum. Measured cause: the evidence is complementary (a span at BM25 rank 3 sits at cosine 147; another at cosine 6 sits at BM25 46), and CombSUM penalised a true single-ranker hit — it REGRESSED the F17 positive control (t17 3->fused 19, dropped). Max keeps every ranker's head high and restored F17 to full coverage. Floor (1d) implemented and unit-tested but defaults 0 (off) for step 1 so it never suppresses a real claim; a value is set from measured cosines in step 2/3. Witness/session hard filter (1b) implemented + unit-tested; a no-op for the 5 real claims (none name a witness), load-bearing for the machine claims (M3 'According to Claire Febey'). Embedding cache lives beside the corpus under sources/hearings/.embcache, gitignored by the existing sources/ rule (E4a exception: it is a regenerable derivative of the intentionally-untracked copyright corpus; re-seed with ASSAY_EMBED=1). go test ./... + staticcheck + vet green.
